assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: OEM advisory - PRD-CLASS-A seal flush plan

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-4210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 2 February 2015 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
